items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: I used to even have to lend him a horn to go play with. Cyril August.

ctx.x: That's right. That's right. That's right.

That's lucky you got through depression like that. I used to, I used to halfway take care of one, one, one, great little now, something else we had. We never met season there. Yeah. We never, we never met season there. I used to even have to lend him a horn to go play with. Cyril August. That's right. That's right. He was good too, man. He had to lend him a horn to go play with. What's his name again? Cyril August.
